items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked there with a group with Jerome Richardson, Wendell Marshall, and Shadow Wilson.

ctx.x: Were you and Wendell Marshall, and Kenny Clarke working outside of the of the recording situations?

No. I worked with Shadow Wilson at a place up… It was at Mittens. Do you remember Mittens? Mittens head sort of gone down from its previous level but they were still doing things there. I worked there with a group with Jerome Richardson, Wendell Marshall, and Shadow Wilson. It was a good group. I had a lot of fun there.
Comment about the personality and the style of Kenny Clarke.

items.title: Jerome Richardson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: You had a nice band on that with Hank Jones... Yeah. Jimmy Cleveland, Hank Jones, Kenny Burrell, Joe Benjamin and Charlie Persip on drums.

ctx.x: Notes by Ira Gitler. You had a nice band on that with Hank Jones and your friend Kenny Burrell.
Yeah. Jimmy Cleveland, Hank Jones, Kenny Burrell, Joe Benjamin and Charlie Persip on drums.
What was it like in the studio for an album like this? Did they give you a day, a couple of days? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
